stories.title: Two Workers Rescued from Hydropower Tunnel After Nine Days in Nepal Floods
stories.summary: Rescue teams in Nepal successfully pulled two workers alive from a hydropower tunnel after they had been trapped for nine days following devastating floods. The floods, which occurred along the Nepal-Tibet border, resulted in over 1,200 fatalities and left many others missing. The rescued individuals sustained injuries and were airlifted to a hospital in Kathmandu for treatment. Efforts continue to locate additional workers believed to be trapped in the tunnels.

stories.title: Russian Drone Attack Targets Ukraine's Security Service Headquarters in Kyiv
stories.summary: A Russian drone struck the headquarters of Ukraine's SBU security service in central Kyiv on Friday afternoon, injuring five people, according to President Volodymyr Zelensky. The attack is seen as a significant escalation, with Zelensky accusing Moscow of targeting the personal office of the SBU head. He has instructed the SBU to respond appropriately to the strike.

stories.summary: The far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party is gaining significant traction in Saxony-Anhalt, potentially becoming the first far-right party to hold state power in Germany since World War II. With upcoming elections, the party's popularity has surged, fueled by social media engagement, raising concerns about its radical agenda and implications for the country's political landscape.

stories.title: Fatal Strike on Iranian Wedding Sparks Mourning and Investigation
stories.summary: A deadly strike on a wedding in Kuhestak, Iran, on September 1 resulted in at least four fatalities, including a child, and over 60 injuries. The incident has led to mourning in the predominantly Baloch community, with residents expressing anger over their situation. The Iranian Red Crescent Society reported that shrapnel from a missile caused the casualties. The U.S. is currently investigating whether its forces were involved in the attack.

stories.title: UK Responds to Argentina's Falklands Claims Amidst Presidential Remarks
stories.summary: The UK government has reaffirmed its commitment to the sovereignty of the Falkland Islands following comments from Argentinian President Javier Milei, who claimed that favorable 'winds of change' support Argentina's assertion over the territory. Milei also threatened sanctions on oil companies operating in the region. UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband emphasized that the UK's position on the islands remains 'unwavering' and that they will uphold the self-determination of the Falkland Islanders.

stories.title: ISRO Successfully Launches EOS-05 Earth Observation Satellite
stories.summary: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has successfully launched the EOS-05, its first imaging satellite, using the GSLV-F17 rocket. The satellite, weighing 2,367 kilograms, is positioned in a Sub-Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit approximately 36,000 kilometers above Earth, and is referred to as India's 'eye in the sky.'
